name: Ricardo Izquierdo
bio:
Ricardo's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a mechanical engineer, he found himself drawn to the tactical challenges presented by racing. He started as a data analyst for a small karting team, quickly proving his knack for identifying crucial performance gains through meticulous analysis. His ability to dissect complex data sets and translate them into actionable strategies earned him a reputation as a rising star.

Ricardo is known for his methodical approach to race strategy, meticulously planning every scenario and contingency. His calm demeanor under pressure and dedication to the team make him a valued asset. While not the most outwardly innovative strategist, his deep technical understanding and commitment to proven methodologies provide a solid foundation for success. He believes in incremental improvements and data-driven decisions, ensuring a consistent and reliable performance.

physical.description: Ricardo has a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a specific ritual of cleaning his glasses before every major race decision.
Insists on drinking only Colombian coffee, regardless of location.
